_about: Hand-labelled sample of auto-matched BOQ lines (labelled by the implementing agent on 2026-10-05, not by the owner). Headings, descriptions and units only: no rates, no contractor names. tuning = 137 lines drawn first (seed 20261005) and used to fix rules; holdout = 100 distinct texts drawn afterwards (seed 777) from texts not in the tuning set. firstPassCorrect records whether the matcher was right BEFORE any fix found by that set. split = which rate columns the original line priced (an input, kept because scope depends on it).
